title: The OpenStack Summit Sponsorship Agreement is now available!
description: Archived announcement of the San Diego 2012 OpenStack Summit sponsorship agreement, with links to the historical agreement and prospectus.
body:
Interested sponsors can now download and complete the sponsorship agreement:

  • Sponsorship Agreement (PDF File)

Read over all the details for this event in the Sponsor Prospectus. Sponsorships are limited, and will be sold on a first come, first served basis as determined by the timing of signed agreements received by sponsors@openstack.org
seoTitle: OpenStack Summit San Diego 2012 — The OpenStack Summit Sponsorship Agreement is now available!
archiveNotice: Archived event content. Dates, registration information and policies below apply to this historical Summit.
